name: eop-reloadend-g0
about: Candidate 1 parity (1b), lead 2026-10-09: after a reload that Safari restores at the end of the page, is the touch jack attached before the first swipe? Approach drags to y>=4600 (below the g0 hold at ~5213 on the Simulator, so nothing opens before the reload), reload (Safari restores the scroll position), 3 s, then two finger-up drags (520 px, 1200 ms) into the hold: it must be held (touchmoves cancelable and prevented, the morph opens) like on g0.0h. Counts only.
